actual_analytic_calculation.inverse_and_determinant: E=e^(2beta), h=r^2 gamma. g^ur=-E^-1, g^rr=E^-1 V/r, g^rA=-E^-1 U^A, g^AB=h^AB, g^uu=g^uA=0. det(g)=-E^2 r^4 det(q). Therefore contracted Christoffels are exactly T_u=2 beta_u, T_r=2/r+2 beta_r, T_A=partial_A log sqrt(det q)+2 beta_A.
actual_analytic_calculation.radial_constraint: The proof derives H^B_A=Gamma^B_rA=delta^B_A/r-C^B_A/(2r^2)+O(r^-3), T^r_A=Gamma^r_rA=-w_A/r+O(r^-2), and the angular connection difference S. In Ric_rA the two order-r^-2 quadratic contributions S^C_AB H^B_C and H^C_A T^r_C cancel with coefficients +w_A and -w_A. Remaining linear contributions give Ric_rA=r^-2(-w_A-(1/2)D_B C^B_A)+O(r^-3). Vacuum yields w^A=U_(2)^A=-(1/2)D_B C^AB.
actual_analytic_calculation.supplementary_linear_part: Set K^a_b=Gamma^a_ub. The exact trace formula reduces Ric_uu to partial_u K^u_u-2 beta_uu + partial_r K^r_u +(2/r)K^r_u +D_A K^A_u plus beta derivative products and -tr(K^2). Their leading contributions are respectively -m_u,+m_u,-2m_u,-D_A w_u^A, all at r^-2; beta products are O(r^-4).
actual_analytic_calculation.supplementary_quadratic_part: K^u_u,K^u_A,K^r_r,K^A_u=O(r^-2); K^u_r=0; K^r_u,K^r_A=O(r^-1); K^A_r=O(r^-4); K^A_B=N^A_B/(2r)+O(r^-2). Thus uu/rr products O(r^-4), ur zero, uA O(r^-4), rA O(r^-5), angular block N_AB N^AB/(4r^2)+O(r^-3). This exhausts every pair in tr(K^2).
actual_analytic_calculation.result: Ric_uu=r^-2(-2 m_u-D_A w_u^A-(1/4)N_AB N^AB)+O(r^-3)=r^-2(-2 m_u+(1/2)D_A D_B N^AB-(1/4)N_AB N^AB)+O(r^-3). Vacuum gives the unchanged approved mass-aspect equation.
actual_analytic_calculation.subleading_and_regularities: Exact determinant traces cancel every angular-determinant time derivative, including trace_q(P)-(1/2)C^2 and its first two u derivatives. Trace-free P remains unrestricted; its remaining K contributions enter tr(K^2) only at r^-3. U_(3),V_(1) enter the retained Christoffel components one order too low. No beta_(3) coefficient is assumed to exist: cancellation of beta_uu is exact and the remaining products are bounded. Only the already stated differentiated remainder bounds through total order two are used. No logarithmic exclusion beyond the existing expansion, additional polarization restriction, or extra smoothness hypothesis was introduced.
actual_analytic_calculation.independent_sign_sanity_calculation: Specialize E=1,U=0,gamma=q,V=r-2m(u). Exact symbols are Gamma^u_uu=-m/r^2, Gamma^r_uu=-m_u/r+m/r^2-2m^2/r^3 and Gamma^r_ur=m/r^2. In the trace formula the r^-3 and r^-4 terms cancel, leaving Ric_uu=-2m_u/r^2 exactly. This verifies the old internal coefficient sign error without changing the vacuum consequence.
